description: This file defines the Headers class that manages HTTP headers for the Slim Framework's PSR7 implementation, including adding, removing, retrieving, and setting headers, as well as parsing special headers like Authorization.

classes.name: Headers
classes.description: A class that implements HeadersInterface to manage HTTP headers, providing methods to manipulate header data such as add, remove, get, set, and parse headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Headers instance with optional headers and globals.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the collection, appending if it already exists.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header from the collection.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the values of a specified header.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets a header, replacing existing values.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers, optionally preserving original case.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderName
methods.description: Normalizes header names for internal processing.

methods.name: parseAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Extracts and determines the Authorization header from incoming headers or globals.

methods.name: prepareHeader
methods.description: Prepares header name and value for setting, including validation and normalization.

methods.name: validateHeader
methods.description: Validates header name and value against RFC 7230.

methods.name: validateHeaderName
methods.description: Ensures header name complies with token characters as per RFC 7230.

methods.name: validateHeaderValue
methods.description: Ensures header value is RFC 7230 compatible.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Headers instance populated from PHP globals.
